_note: P12.8 building reveals (plan-cinematic section 6), read by Sim/Cine/Reveals. Angles in degrees, times in real seconds, distance in subject radii, heights in meters. Shot limits come from Data/cine/shots.json; every reveal must pass CutLint and fit sceneSeconds.reveal (6 to 15 s).

towerFloors.why: Towers of 6 floors or more get the crane reveal.

topTier.why: A tower whose tallest cells carry this tenant tier adds lights on.

low.why: Low buildings get a dolly in and a short orbit after the timelapse.

tower.why: Towers of 6 floors or more get the crane reveal.

topTier.why: Owner call 50: same rule as the landmark. Keep the timelapse, drop the crane landing so the crane lands straight on the lights: 6.5 + 4 + 4 = 14.5 s, under the 15 s cap.

landmark.why: Owner call 50: same rule as top tier. A landmark gets all three; with the hero low landing it runs 17 s, so the crane lands straight on the lights. The landmark flag adds only the short timelapse (6 s), so 14 s.
